description: This file defines utility functions used in a Windows environment for a Flutter app. It includes functions for creating consoles, converting UTF-16 strings to UTF-8, and retrieving command line arguments.

methods.name: CreateAndAttachConsole
methods.description: Creates a console for the process and redirects stdout and stderr to it for both the runner and the Flutter library.

methods.name: Utf8FromUtf16
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated wchar_t* encoded in UTF-16 into a std::string encoded in UTF-8. Returns empty string on failure.

methods.name: GetCommandLineArguments
methods.description: Retrieves command line arguments as a vector of UTF-8 encoded strings. Returns an empty vector on failure.
